instructions_g1.text:
In this block, your partner will be expressing concepts by only using gestures and movements of their upper body.

Your task is to guess the meaning of the performance by typing the answer on the keyboard. You will be asked to type the answer only after your partner finished their performance.

If your guess is not correct, your partner will have another chance to perform the intended meaning. Try to not think about the correct answer too much and go with your intuition. You have 3 chances to guess the correct meaning.

 It can be any type of word (noun, verb, adjective etc.), but it is always only one word.

During the game, do not talk or interact with your partner.

instructions_p1.text:
In this block, your task is to perform the meanings you will see on the screen in front of you, only by using gestures and movements of your upper body. 

The rules are: 

You can make movements with your hands and upper body
You cannot point to objects on you and in your environment – imagine you are naked and have no objects around you. You can only point to parts of your body.
You must not make any sounds

After you finish your initial performance, your partner will be asked to type in their guess. If it is correct, you can proceed to next word. If the guess is not correct, the wrong answer will be displayed on the screen in front of you and you will be given another chance to perform the intended meaning. In total, you have 3 chances to perform the meaning.

During the game, do not talk or interact with your partner.
